name: Split Modalities
description: Split a 4D NIfTI file into separate modality files for nnUNet processing. Handles BRATS dataset format with FLAIR, T1w, t1gd, and T2w modalities.
detailed_description: Split a 4D NIfTI file into separate modality files for nnUNet processing. Handles BRATS dataset format with FLAIR, T1w, t1gd, and T2w modalities.
when_to_use: When you need split modalities analysis

parameters.input_file: [Required] Path to the 4D NIfTI file to split (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Required] Directory to save the split modality files (str)
parameters.case_name: [Optional] Base name for the case files (default: BRAT)
